options.content:
- Use Cases: This dashboard shows the basic Git and Code Review metrics from GitLab.
- Data Source Required: GitLab

panels.description: Counts distinct pull requests created in the selected time range for the selected GitLab repositories (`repo_id`). The time filter uses `created_date`, so this measures intake rather than merges.

targets.rawSql:
select
	count(distinct pr.id) as pull_request_count
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))

panels.title: 1.1 Number of New Pull Requests

panels.description: Counts distinct pull requests by their creation date, grouped into weeks or months according to the dashboard interval, for the selected repositories. The date filter uses `created_date`; the displayed bucket label follows the chosen interval.

targets.rawSql:
with _prs as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(created_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(created_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    count(distinct id) as pr_count
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE
    base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    and $__timeFilter(created_date)
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and created_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  group by 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  pr_count as "Pull Request Count"
FROM _prs
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 1.2 Number of New Pull Requests

panels.description: Ranks the 20 `author_name` values with the most merged pull requests among PRs created in the selected time range and selected repositories. The time filter is on `created_date`, not `merged_date`; status is DevLake's normalized `MERGED` value.

targets.rawSql:
-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to DevLake's statuses 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
select
  author_name,
	count(distinct pr.id) as merged_pull_request_count
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
	and pr.status = 'MERGED'
group by 1
order by 2 desc
limit 20

panels.title: 1.3 Top 20 Contributors By Merged PRs

panels.description: Closed-without-merge PRs divided by all PRs in `CLOSED` or `MERGED` status, for PRs created in the selected time range and selected repositories. Open PRs are excluded from the denominator; the result is a fraction (0–1), not a count.

targets.rawSql:
-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to DevLake's statuses 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
select
  count(distinct case when status = 'CLOSED' then id else null end)/count(distinct case when status in ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') then id else null end) as ratio
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))

panels.title: 2.1 Ratio of unmerged MRs of All Closed or Merged PRs

panels.description: Counts open, closed-without-merge, and merged PRs by creation week or month for the selected repositories. The selected time range applies to `created_date`; statuses are DevLake's normalized `OPEN`, `CLOSED`, and `MERGED` values.

targets.rawSql:
-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
with _prs as (
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(created_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(created_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    count(distinct case when status = 'OPEN' then id else null end) as open,
    count(distinct case when status = 'CLOSED' then id else null end) as closed,
    count(distinct case when status = 'MERGED' then id else null end) as merged
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(created_date)
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and created_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
    and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  group by 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  open as "MR: Open",
  closed as "MR: Closed without merging",
  merged as "MR: Closed and merged"
FROM _prs
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 2.2 Merge Request Status Distribution

panels.description: Counts distinct PRs in DevLake's `CLOSED` status that were created during the selected time range in the selected repositories. This excludes merged PRs and filters by creation date, not close date.

targets.rawSql:
-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to DevLake's statuses 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
select
	count(distinct pr.id) as merged_pull_request_count
from 
	pull_requests pr
where
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
	and pr.status = 'CLOSED'

panels.title: 2.3 Number of MRs Closed without Merging

panels.description: Shows the weekly or monthly fraction of closed-without-merge PRs among PRs that are either `CLOSED` or `MERGED`, grouped and time-filtered by `created_date` for the selected repositories. Open PRs are excluded; the result is a fraction (0–1).

targets.rawSql:
-- The PR/MR statuses are standardized to 'OPEN', 'MERGED' and 'CLOSED'. You can check out the original status from the field `original_status`
SELECT
  DATE_ADD(date(created_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(created_date))+1 DAY) as time,
  count(distinct case when status = 'CLOSED' then id else null end)/count(distinct case when status in ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') then id else null end) as ratio
FROM pull_requests
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
  and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
group by 1

panels.title: 2.4 Ratio of unmerged MRs of All Closed or Merged MRs

panels.description: Average elapsed time in days from `created_date` to `merged_date` for PRs with a merge date, scoped to the selected repositories. The dashboard time range is applied to `created_date`, so it groups by when PRs were opened rather than when they merged.

targets.rawSql:
select
	avg(TIMESTAMPDIFF(Minute,created_date,merged_date)/1440)
from 
	pull_requests
where 
  $__timeFilter(created_date)
	and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
	and merged_date is not null

panels.title: 2.5 Mean Time to Merge of Merge Requests

panels.description: Average elapsed time in days from PR creation to merge, grouped by creation week or month for the selected repositories. Only PRs with `merged_date` contribute; the selected time range filters `created_date`.

targets.rawSql:
with _prs as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(created_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(created_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    avg(TIMESTAMPDIFF(Minute,created_date,merged_date)/1440) as time_to_merge
  FROM pull_requests
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(created_date)
    and base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and created_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  group by 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  time_to_merge as "Time to Merge"
FROM _prs
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 2.6 Mean Time to Merge of MRs

panels.description: Counts distinct successful GitLab pipeline runs completed in the selected time range for the selected repository scopes. The query uses `finished_date`, requires `result = 'SUCCESS'`, and limits pipeline IDs to those containing `gitlab`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(distinct id)
FROM 
  cicd_pipelines
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(finished_date)
  and result = 'SUCCESS'
  and id like "%gitlab%"
  and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
-- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
  -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)

panels.title: 3.1 Number of successful pipeline runs

panels.description: Calculates successful GitLab pipeline runs divided by all distinct GitLab pipeline runs in the selected range and repository scopes. It filters on `finished_date` and also drops results before the first day of the month after the selected range's start month, to avoid a partial starting month; despite the panel title, this is one aggregate rate, not an average of monthly rates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  1.0 * count(case when result = 'SUCCESS' then id else null end)/count(distinct id)
FROM cicd_pipelines
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(finished_date)
  and id like "%gitlab%"
  and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
  and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)

panels.title: 3.2 Mean pipeline run success rate %

panels.description: Counts successful and non-NULL, non-successful GitLab pipeline results by completion week or month for the selected repository scopes. The selected time range is applied to `finished_date`; rows with a NULL result are not included in either count.

targets.rawSql:
with _builds as (
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(finished_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(finished_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    count(distinct case when result = 'SUCCESS' then id else null end) as successful_count,
    count(distinct case when result != 'SUCCESS' then id else null end) as failed_count
  FROM cicd_pipelines
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(finished_date)
    and id like "%gitlab%"
    and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  successful_count,
  failed_count
FROM _builds
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 3.3 Number of successful and failed pipeline runs

panels.description: Shows the count of completed GitLab pipeline runs by result for the selected time range and repository scopes. The time filter uses `finished_date`; an empty-string result is displayed as `Unknown` (a SQL NULL remains NULL).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  IF(result = '', 'Unknown', result) as result,
  count(distinct id) as build_count
FROM cicd_pipelines
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(finished_date)
  and id like "%gitlab%"
  and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
  -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 desc

panels.title: 3.4 Pipeline runs result distribution

panels.description: Shows successful GitLab runs divided by all runs in each completion week or month for the selected repository scopes. The time range filters `finished_date`; this is a per-period rate, not a mean of individual run rates.

targets.rawSql:
WITH _build_success_rate as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(finished_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(finished_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    result,
    id
  FROM
    cicd_pipelines
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(finished_date)
    and id like "%gitlab%"
    and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  GROUP BY 
    time, result, id
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%m/%Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  1.0 * sum(case when result = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end)/ count(*) as "Pipeline Runs Success Rate"
FROM _build_success_rate
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 3.5 Pipeline run success rate %

panels.description: Calculates average GitLab pipeline duration in minutes for the selected completion-date range and repository scopes. The query uses `finished_date` and excludes results earlier than the first day of the month after the selected range's start month, which removes a partial starting month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  avg(duration_sec/60) as duration_in_minutes
FROM cicd_pipelines
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(finished_date)
  and id like "%gitlab%"
  and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
  and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)

panels.title: 3.6 Mean pipeline runs duration

panels.description: Shows average GitLab pipeline duration in seconds by completion week or month for the selected repository scopes. The selected time range filters `finished_date`; the plotted series is grouped by completion period.

targets.rawSql:
WITH _builds as(
  SELECT
    DATE_ADD(date(finished_date), INTERVAL -$interval(date(finished_date))+1 DAY) as time,
    avg(duration_sec) as mean_duration_sec
  FROM 
    cicd_pipelines
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(finished_date)
    and id like "%gitlab%"
    and cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    -- Enable the following condition to remove the month with incomplete data
    -- and finished_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL -DAY($__timeFrom())+1 DAY), INTERVAL +1 MONTH)
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT 
  case when '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' then date_format(time,'%M %Y') else concat('W', date_format(time,'%u %Y')) end as _time,
  mean_duration_sec
FROM _builds
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 3.7 Mean pipeline run duration

options.content: This dashboard is created based on this [data schema](https://devlake.apache.org/docs/DataModels/DevLakeDomainLayerSchema). Want to add more metrics? Please follow the [guide](https://devlake.apache.org/docs/Configuration/Dashboards/GrafanaUserGuide).

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT upm.project_name
FROM user_project_mapping upm
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.project_name = upm.project_name
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
  AND pm.row_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name
list.label: Project
list.name: project
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT upm.project_name
FROM user_project_mapping upm
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.project_name = upm.project_name
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
  AND pm.row_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name

list.definition:
SELECT CONCAT(r.name, '--', r.id) AS text
FROM project_mapping pm
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
  AND pm.row_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))
ORDER BY text
list.label: Repo
list.name: repo_id
list.query:
SELECT CONCAT(r.name, '--', r.id) AS text
FROM project_mapping pm
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pm.row_id
WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos'
  AND pm.row_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project}))
ORDER BY text

title: GitLab
description: GitLab pull-request and CI pipeline metrics for the selected repositories and time range. PR panels generally filter by creation date; pipeline panels filter by completion date. PR status values are DevLake's normalized OPEN, MERGED, and CLOSED values.
